title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Provisions on Procedures for Chinese Citizens Applying for Recognition of Foreign Court Divorce Judgments

articles.content_en:
Article 1 For a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court that has not concluded a judicial assistance agreement with China, a Chinese party may, in accordance with these Provisions, apply to the People's Court for recognition of the divorce judgment of the foreign court.
For a divorce judgment rendered by a foreign court that has concluded a judicial assistance agreement with China, the application for recognition shall be made in accordance with the provisions of the agreement.

Article 2 These Provisions shall not apply to the recognition and enforcement of judgments on the division of property between spouses, the burden of alimony, and the custody of children in the divorce judgments of foreign courts.

Article 3 To apply to the People's Court for recognition of a divorce judgment of a foreign court, the applicant shall submit a written application, and shall attach the original copy of the foreign court's divorce judgment and a verified Chinese translation. Otherwise, the application shall not be accepted.

Article 5 The application shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court at the place of the applicant's domicile. If the applicant's domicile is inconsistent with his/her habitual residence, the Intermediate People's Court at his/her habitual residence shall accept the application.
If the applicant is not within China, the Intermediate People's Court at the applicant's original domestic domicile shall accept the application.

Article 6 Upon receiving the application, the People's Court shall, after examination, if it meets the acceptance conditions of these Provisions, docket the case within seven days; if it does not meet the conditions, it shall notify the applicant of non-acceptance within seven days and state the reasons.

Article 7 The People's Court shall examine the application for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment by forming a collegial panel composed of three adjudicators, and the ruling made shall not be appealed.

Article 8 After accepting the application, if the foreign court's divorce judgment does not indicate that it has taken effect or the effective date, the People's Court shall order the applicant to submit a document issued by the court that rendered the judgment certifying that the judgment has taken effect.

Article 9 If the plaintiff in the divorce judgment rendered by the foreign court is the applicant, the People's Court shall order the applicant to submit relevant documents proving that the foreign court that rendered the judgment has lawfully summoned the defendant to appear in court.

Article 10 The supporting documents required to be submitted under Articles 8 and 9 shall be notarized by the notarization department of the foreign country and authenticated by the Chinese embassy or consulate in that country. At the same time, the applicant shall provide a verified Chinese translation.

Article 11 If the defendant in the foreign court's divorce judgment who resides within China is the applicant and has difficulty in submitting the supporting documents required under Articles 8 and 10 as well as notarization and authentication, if the applicant can submit the foreign court's notice of response to the lawsuit or summons to appear in court, the foreign court's divorce judgment may be presumed to be authentic and to have taken effect.

Article 13 The recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment shall be made by a ruling. If there is no circumstance as stipulated in Article 12, the ruling shall recognize its legal effect; if there is any circumstance as stipulated in Article 12, the ruling shall reject the applicant's application.

Article 14 The ruling shall be made in the name of the "×× Intermediate People's Court of the People's Republic of China", signed by the members of the collegial panel, and affixed with the seal of the People's Court.
Article 15 The ruling shall take legal effect upon service.
Article 16 To apply for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment, the applicant shall pay to the People's Court a case acceptance fee of RMB 100 yuan.

Article 17 If an applicant entrusts another person to act as agent for applying for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment, the applicant must submit to the People's Court a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal. If the power of attorney is executed abroad, it must be certified by the Chinese embassy or consulate in that country.

Article 18 After the People's Court accepts a divorce action, if the plaintiff changes the claim to apply for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment, or if the defendant separately files an application for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment, such application shall not be accepted.

Article 19 After the People's Court accepts an application for recognition of a foreign court's divorce judgment, if the other party files a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 20 Even if the marriage between the parties has been adjudged by a foreign court, if no application for recognition has been filed with the People's Court, it shall not prevent either party from separately filing a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.

Article 21 After the applicant's application is accepted by the People's Court, the applicant may withdraw the application, and the People's Court shall grant the withdrawal by a ruling. After the applicant withdraws the application, the applicant shall not file another application, but may separately file a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.
Article 22 After the applicant's application is rejected, the applicant shall not file another application, but may separately file a divorce lawsuit with the People's Court.
